sketch:
Observe: SVG scene with a white-light source, a triangular prism, and
a screen; student drags the prism to rotate its orientation and sees
the spectrum band (rouge → violet) fan out on the screen from a
Canvas 2D gradient. HUD reads deviation angle per wavelength.
Experiment: 3 seeded colored slits on the screen; student rotates
prism so each spectral band-region aligns with its matching slit.
Evaluate: only the incident white ray and the slit targets visible —
dispersed rays hidden; student must place prism using memorized
ordering of colors. Wrinkle: 2ème vision-level treatment
(qualitative), not Bac dispersion.
